title: Sebastian Lustrier's letters and reports from Constantinople to Rambaldo Collalto, 26 pieces, mostly in cipher
correspondents: Sebastian Lustrier (imperial resident at the Porte) -> Rambaldo Collalto (president of the Hofkriegsrat)
shelfmark: MZA Brno, G 169 Rodinný archiv Collaltů Brtnice, I. část, inv. č. 1774
folio_note: 26 pieces, "většinou šifrováno" (mostly enciphered) per the inventory
status: MZA inventory: "Dopisy a zprávy Lustriera z Cařihradu; 26 kusů, většinou šifrováno". No decipherment mentioned. Same sender as catalogue #1227 (Lustrier/Radibrati -> Ferdinand II, HHStA Türkei I Kt. 108-111, ciphered 1621-31, no decipherment): the Hofkriegsrat copy-stream of the same intelligence, probably the same cipher. inv. 1776 of this fonds holds a Collalto-Harrach key and more Lustrier letters (separate row).
why: Habsburg intelligence from the Porte in the years of the Bethlen Gábor wars and the 1627 Szőny peace, addressed to the head of the war council; a second archive of the Lustrier cipher doubles the ciphertext for #1227.
verify: Order scans of inv. 1774 and inv. 1776 (key); compare the cipher with catalogue #1227 and with the Kurtz von Senftenau ciphers printed in the Graz GAMS edition (1623-24).

title: Prince Christian II of Anhalt-Bernburg to Wilhelm Verdugo: letters in cipher
correspondents: Christian II (the Younger), Prince of Anhalt-Bernburg -> Wilhelm (Guillermo) Verdugo, imperial colonel, from 1623 governor of the Lower Palatinate

title: Vittorio Fossombroni to Count Marulli, Tuscan envoy to the Cisalpine Republic: ciphered letters, with the Grand Duke's ciphers
correspondents: Vittorio Fossombroni (Tuscan foreign minister) -> Count G. Marulli (Tuscan envoy at Milan)
shelfmark: Národní archiv, Rodinný archiv toskánských Habsburků - Ferdinand III. (NAD 1044/2), inv. č. 7, kart. 1
folio_note: folder 1798-1799: ciphers used by Grand Duke Ferdinand III in correspondence with political figures, and ciphered letters of Fossombroni to Marulli
status: NA finding aid no. 474 (RAT díl IV): "Šifry užívané v písemném styku velkovévody Ferdinanda s různými osobnostmi politického života. Šifrované dopisy V. Fossombroniho toskánskému vyslanci v cisalpské republice hraběti Marullimu." Keys and ciphertext in the same folder; no decipherment mentioned.
why: Tuscany's foreign minister instructing his envoy to the French sister-republic in the months before the French occupation of Tuscany (March 1799); the Grand Duke's own cipher tables filed with them.
verify: Order scans of kart. 1; apply the filed ciphers; check the Fossombroni papers in the Archivio di Stato di Arezzo and the Esteri files in the Archivio di Stato di Firenze for Marulli's side.
access_note: description only in the Národní archiv VadeMeCum (no scans of the documents); order scans from the Národní archiv, Praha (Chodovec)

correspondents: unknown -> Clemens von Metternich (Austrian foreign minister)
